about: Read each sentence aloud and save it as evals/voice/<id>.m4a (or .wav / .mp3). The terms are the subject words that matter most for grading.

sentences.text: At balance, no current flows through the galvanometer of a Wheatstone bridge.
sentences.context: When is a Wheatstone bridge balanced?

sentences.text: Drift velocity is very small because electrons keep colliding, and the relaxation time between collisions is short.
sentences.context: Explain why drift velocity depends on relaxation time.

sentences.text: Kirchhoff's junction rule follows from the conservation of charge.
sentences.context: Why is the junction rule a consequence of conservation of charge?

sentences.text: Nichrome and manganin have a very small temperature coefficient of resistivity.
sentences.context: Why are alloys like nichrome used in standard resistors?

sentences.text: The terminal voltage is less than the EMF while the cell is supplying current.
sentences.context: What is the difference between EMF and terminal voltage?

sentences.text: Gallium arsenide is non-ohmic because more than one voltage can give the same current.
sentences.context: Give an example of a non-ohmic material.

sentences.text: Umm, so one kilowatt hour is, uh, basically three point six million joules.
Wheatstone bridge balance hota hai jab galvanometer mein koi current nahi hota.
sentences.context: When is a Wheatstone bridge balanced?

sentences.text: Drift velocity bahut kam hoti hai kyunki electrons baar baar collide karte hain.
Matlab semiconductor ko garam karne par uski resistivity kam ho jaati hai.
sentences.context: What happens to a semiconductor's resistivity when heated?
